system.description: Use this Skill if you want to move undetected or surprise a Mob. Make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. On Success before combat starts, you are unnoticed and gain 1 non-Attack Action. On Success in a non-combat situation, you remain unnoticed and can perform a Move Action with a 10ft Step as part of this Check.

upgrades.description: Your surprise Action can be an Attack with Advantage.
When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
On a successful Surprise Check, you may also take a full Move and Step. If you Attack with your Surprise Action, deal x2 the base damage dice.

system.limitations: You must be out of sight of all foes to begin this Check.
